essence: Recitation of one hundred thousand repetitions is to be avoided even for a guru who is merely a woman.
After performing libation and cleansing, one should feed brahmins.
One who worships the gods becomes a bringer of joy to the world.
One who daily offers a hundred or more libations will certainly attain the stated result.
The offering involves something smeared with sandal paste together with jasmine flowers and barley.
